Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives are fruit, so they don’t have muscles, bones, or physical strength at all. Ripe black olives are also usually cured, which makes them relatively soft—so a person can easily crush or bite them.

Why are black olives so much weaker than men?

Black olives aren’t meaningfully comparable to men in “strength.” If you meant **black olives versus green olives**, black olives are usually fully ripe and often canned, which makes them softer and less firm. Green olives are harvested earlier and tend to have a firmer, more bitter texture.
